briefdescription.para: A fast alternative to std::function with improved performance.

detaileddescription.para: The delegate class is a template class that allows to call functions, member functions, and lambda expressions as delegates. It does not provide ownership handling and lifetime management. The using function needs to make sure that the object and method pointers are valid.
